blocks.text:
## Programme prices for 2027

| Accommodation | Price per person, USD |
|---|---:|
| Tapuy Lodge | 2 293 |
| Waku Lodge | 2 581 |

The rate includes 3 nights in Canaima, Caracas — Canaima — Caracas flights, ground transfers in Canaima, guides and local staff, excursions to Angel Falls and Sapo Falls, kayaking, daily light snacks and meals according to the programme. The national park fee of 40 USD is paid separately.

The Word table lists both lodges; the day-two text names Waku Lodge. The selected lodge, room category, occupancy type and applicability of the programme to the rate are confirmed when booking.

## Meals

Breakfast, lunch and dinner are listed for days 1–3. On day 1, after check-in, enjoy a buffet lunch overlooking the lagoon and a romantic dinner in the evening. On day 2, lunch is included in the excursion day. Breakfast is included on day 4.

## Optional excursions

| Excursion | Price, USD |
|---|---:|
| Full-day Kavac with a flight over Angel Falls | 562 |
| Pozo Azul — Blue Pool | 88 |
| Kuravaina trek and Pozo Azul | 125 |
| Yuri-Yuri Lu | 89 |
| Helicopter excursion, group of up to 6 people | 4 125 per group |

Optional excursions are paid separately. The helicopter price is for the entire group of up to 6 people. The duration and schedule of optional trips are confirmed when booking.
